user.title: Connect Kaloricke Tabulky
user.description: Enter your Kaloricke Tabulky credentials. The password is used only to sign in and create a session cookie.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Kaloricke Tabulky.

abort.already_configured: This Kaloricke Tabulky account is already configured.

init.title: Kaloricke Tabulky options
init.description: Manage sensor refresh and quick food buttons.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Set how often Home Assistant should refresh sensors. The default is 240 minutes because the API is unofficial and body weight usually changes slowly.

add_quick_food.title: Add quick food button
add_quick_food.description: Search Kaloricke Tabulky for the food or drink that should be recorded by one button press.

select_quick_food.title: Select food
select_quick_food.description: Choose the exact Kaloricke Tabulky item.

quick_food_details.title: Quick food details
quick_food_details.description: Set the amount and unit that the button should record. The diary date and time are filled from the current Home Assistant time when the button is pressed.

import_recipes.title: Import custom recipe buttons
import_recipes.description: Create one-portion quick food buttons for custom recipes in Kaloricke Tabulky. Existing buttons for the same recipe are skipped.

remove_quick_food.title: Remove quick food button
remove_quick_food.description: Remove a configured quick food button.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Kaloricke Tabulky.
error.no_food_found: No matching food or drink was found.

record_weight.name: Record weight
record_weight.description: Record a body weight value in Kaloricke Tabulky.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional account entry ID. Required only when multiple accounts are configured.

date.name: Date
date.description: Optional date for the recorded weight. Defaults to today. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY.

search_food.name: Search food
search_food.description: Search Kaloricke Tabulky foods or drinks and return matching food GUIDs.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional account entry ID. Required only when multiple accounts are configured.

record_food.name: Record food
record_food.description: Record a food or drink item in the Kaloricke Tabulky diary.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional account entry ID. Required only when multiple accounts are configured.

query.name: Query
query.description: Food or drink search text. Use either query or food_guid.

food_guid.name: Food GUID
food_guid.description: Exact Kaloricke Tabulky food GUID from search_food. Use either query or food_guid.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Record either a food or a drink when query is used.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Optional positive amount, for example 250 with unit ml or 100 with unit g.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Optional unit hint, for example g, ml, kg or l.

unit_guid.name: Unit GUID
unit_guid.description: Exact unit GUID from the Kaloricke Tabulky add form. Advanced use only.

date.name: Date
date.description: Optional diary date. Defaults to today. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY.

time.name: Time
time.description: Optional exact diary time. Defaults to the current Home Assistant time. Use HH:MM.

meal_type.name: Meal type
meal_type.description: Optional meal type override. If omitted, the integration assigns it from time.
